## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1-2"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/dense-data/drawer/card-1.png" alt="Panel and scrim: 1, 2" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><i class="odv-am-n">2</i><b>Panel and scrim</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What holds this?">Containment</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="What sits on top?">Layering</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Elevation · What rises above the page? → Only what floats</div><div class="odv-am-why">Only menus and dialogs float; cards use lines.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Elevation · How soft are shadows? → Subtle</div><div class="odv-am-why">Subtle shadows keep the grid crisp.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Shape · What should control corners say? → Slightly rounded</div><div class="odv-am-why">Small corners keep dense rows straight.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For a menu or dialog, use elevation.overlay and a dimmed page for dialogs. Don't use a border only.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Floating things need a shadow so they read as on top.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.scrim</code><span>→</span><code>overlay.background</code><span class="odv-am-val">#0000008C · dark #000000B3</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The see-through layer behind a modal.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> black.light.scrim: a see-through layer that dims the page behind a modal, so the dialog is the one thing to act on.</div><div><b>Dark</b> black.dark.scrim: a see-through layer that dims the page behind a modal, so the dialog is the one thing to act on.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.canvas</code><span>→</span><code>content.background</code><span class="odv-am-val">#F7F8FA · dark #0D1117</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The page background behind everything.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.50, under content: 1.06:1 from surface.default, so cards and panels stand forward.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.0, under content: 1.1:1 from surface.default, so cards and panels stand forward.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>elevation.overlay</code><span>→</span><code>content.shadow</code><span class="odv-am-val">0px 8px 24px, #0D111729 · dark 0px 8px 24px, #00000080</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> shadow.overlay: Subtle shadows keep the grid crisp.</div><div><b>Dark</b> shadow.overlay-dark: Subtle shadows keep the grid crisp.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>radius.container</code><span>→</span><code>content.radius</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.25rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> radius.4: Small corners keep dense rows straight.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.border.default</code><span>→</span><code>content.border</code><span class="odv-am-val">#DDE2EA · dark #3D4655</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.22:1, on surface.canvas). ## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `drawer`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy dense-data drawer`
